entities.observe: A market crate, swollen and burst, washed down through a grate above. Whatever was in it fed something down here long ago.
entities.toast: A ruined crate, half-sunk in silt. Merchant stamps still show under the rot: lost cargo, swallowed by the sewers and picked clean.

entities.observe: Cable-thick silk, black-and-silver banded, stretched wall to wall. Not a house spider's work. Something with a shield on its back spun this, and recently.
entities.toast: Ropes of banded silk choke the side passage, strong as wire. Wrapped in it, drained pale: a rat, a boot, something that used to be a Watchman's lantern.

entities._comment: The sewers' easy trash fight -- the sewers_walkthrough clears it (autoplay). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so QA controls when it starts.

The Shield Spider nest -- Quest 1 'Something in the Cisterns' FIGHT path (C3 wires the quest; on_victory banks cleared_the_nest for C3 to read). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so C3's SKILL path can [Appraise Foe] the nest without triggering combat. Phosphor_pendant loot rides the sewers-phosphor prop fiction. This encounter carried NO loot table before G2 (confirmed by grep), so the new table is purely additive -- no prior loot draw exists at any pinned seed for this entity to disturb. Loot RNG is isolated (hash(run_seed, encounter_id), M7), so this can never shift the main event stream or any OTHER encounter's draw. Chance 0.3 is a G2 pick (the staging doc names the source but not a chance value) -- mid-range between the shipped 0.25/0.5 precedents.
entities.observe: Two of them, banded carapaces catching the moss-light, waiting where the silk is thickest. Their legs test the air toward you. Behind them the tunnel drops away, and more eyes catch the light down there than you want to count.

entities._comment: Quest 1 SKILL path: the walkway ledge overlooking the Shield Spider nest. Mirrors the crate quest's cellar_door [Light] shape -- `requires_skill: observe` + `on_skill_use` banks `scouted_the_nest` deterministically (single accomplishment, zero rng). Both interact (E, facing it -> interact()'s prop branch use_skill('observe', id) fallback) and the field [Appraise Foe] hotbar (use_skill_field -> the requires_skill==observe && on_skill_use branch) route through the SAME use_skill seam, so the bank + toast are identical either way; the generic observe-string path never fires for this prop (the requires_skill+on_skill_use branch is checked first). `locked_toast` gates gracefully when [Appraise Foe] is unknown (no skill-name leak). Placed at (17,10) on the right walkway, one cell east of the open nest floor -- reachable WITHOUT interacting the interact-only shield_spiders at (15,10), so scouting never trips the fight. Sprite `boulder` is a stand-in (a broken brick lip) consistent with the drainage_marker; VISUAL-LOG flag.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — You lie flat on the ledge and read the nest like a map. Two sentries on the silk, a brood-hollow behind them, and a tunnel dropping away toward the Dungeon proper. That's where the rest of them are. Count, size, exits: you have it all, and you never had to draw a blade.

entities.locked_toast: The ledge overlooks the nest: a perfect vantage, if you had the eye to read one. You don't, quite. Not yet.

entities._comment: The descent seam, gated on Act III's tremor beat. A `door_when` prop on the SAME idiom as the street sewer_grate: its gate is `heard_the_deep_tremor` -- Zevara's post-Act-II summons is its SOLE producer (documented in CLAUDE.md). Until banked, door_when is UNMET and interact falls through to on_interact_accomplishment + toast (found_the_fissure) -- pre-gate behavior is byte-identical, so sewers_walkthrough/cisterns_* stay green. Once banked, the same interact emits open_toast and descends to deep_tunnels (2,2). Placed at (8,12), the untouched bottom-middle band -- no sewers/cisterns route asserts or treads a bottom-band cell (all sewers-map cells they visit are top-band y2, the nest right-side y10, and (2,7)). Sprite `boulder` is a rubble stand-in for a collapsed fissure (VISUAL-LOG flag, drainage_marker/nest_ledge precedent).
entities.observe: The floor gave way here, not long ago: a raw crack breathing air colder and older than the sewers ever hold. The claw-scores on its lip all point one way: down. Something climbed up through this, and means to again.
entities.toast: A fresh fissure splits the sewer floor, exhaling a dry, breathing cold from far below. Deep gouges rake the stone lip. Something big has been using this as a door.

door_when.open_toast: You lower yourself into the fissure. The sewer's damp falls away behind you, and a dry, ancient cold rises to meet your hands. The dark below swallows the last of the light from above.

deep_tunnels._comment: The Raskghar descent -- a small (14x10) cave-biome map BELOW the sewers, entered from the sewers `deep_fissure` prop once A3 banks `heard_the_deep_tremor` (see the fissure's door_when seam). DARKEST pin in the game (data/moods.json deep_tunnels, vignette 0.55). A single interact-only scout route-fight (`raskghar_scouts`) blocks the way; two flavor props (cold_hearth = old fires, gnaw_pile = bones) + the `warren_mouth` widened-gallery marker (the 'warren door' deep_descent reaches) dress the escalation. The BOSS encounter (Awakened Raskghar in the deep_warren arena) is A3's climax chain -- A2 ships the map, the scouts, the threshold, and the deep_warren arena/harness band; A3 wires the boss entity at/beyond warren_mouth + the Relc party/veto. Walls: two short rubble columns (x7 top, x4 bottom) that never obstruct the open mid-band (y3-6), so entry->hearth->scouts->warren is always walkable.

floor_layers._pick: cave-floor variation reusing the cave biome's verified floor-tile neighborhood (same picks as sewers/cave_mouth).

segments._comment: A stalactite rubble column hanging from the ceiling (top), x7 y0-2 -- narrows the gallery without touching the open mid-band.
A fallen column rising from the floor (bottom), x4 y7-9.

entities._comment: The way back up to the sewers, beside where the fissure drops you (lands at 2,2).

entities.observe: A ring of fire-blackened stones, the ash inside long dead and cold. Something sat here in the dark and knew how to keep a fire — or learned how, the way they say these things learn, when the moon is full and their minds come clear.
entities.toast: A fire-pit ringed with blackened stones, its ashes cold. Whoever tended it had hands enough to strike a spark, and left gnawed bones banked around the edge, cracked for their marrow.

entities.observe: A midden of cracked bones, marrow sucked clean. Gnoll, most of them. A few too large to name. They have been sorted, almost stacked, as though something down here counts its meals and keeps the score.
entities.toast: A heap of gnawed bones, splintered for their marrow. Some are Gnoll. One is a Drake's. They are stacked, not scattered. And that is worse than if they had been.

entities._comment: The deep_tunnels route-fight -- a Raskghar scout PAIR barring the way to the warren. Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so QA/A3 control the start; deep_descent clears it via combat_autoplay. Fought in cave_mouth (the generic cave arena); the deep_warren arena is reserved for A3's boss. on_victory banks cleared_raskghar_scouts.
entities.observe: Two of them crouch where the tunnel narrows, moon-grey and mountain-shouldered, knuckles to the stone. Their small eyes track you without blinking. Between you and the deeper dark, they are the door — and the lock.

entities._comment: The widened-gallery marker -- the 'warren door' deep_descent reaches (its terminal beat). A flavor threshold prop in A2; A3 wires the Awakened Raskghar boss encounter (deep_warren arena) here / just beyond it, plus the Relc party/veto beat. Placed at (12,5), past the scout route-fight.
entities.observe: The passage opens into a vast pillared gallery, its floor packed smooth by generations of pacing feet. Eyes catch your light far back in the dark and slide away. This is where they den, and where the big one waits, breathing slow in the black.
entities.toast: The tunnel widens into a pillared gallery, the air stirring with breath that is not your own. Something large shifts in the dark ahead, and the pacing scuffs go quiet. You have found the warren.

entities._comment: THE BOSS encounter -- the Awakened Raskghar + 2 scout adds, fought in the deep_warren arena. Interact-triggered (no trigger_radius, so QA/the player choose to engage; it sits just past the warren_mouth threshold at (12,7), reachable by standing at (12,6) facing down). Carries a `conversation` (relc_descent = the Relc join/veto beat, the interact.encounter branch runs it before combat): the [Go together.] branch banks `relc_joined_descent`, satisfying THIS entity's `ally_requires` so Relc fields as an ally; the [I go alone.] branch banks `went_alone` and NEVER banks relc_joined_descent, so the roster fields no ally (the honest, measured 0.04 solo cell -- the player chose it). Both branches end on a `start_combat: awakened_boss` effect (self-reference). on_victory banks `cleared_the_warren`; the seal-beat resolutions (Zevara/Olesm) consume that and bank the Act III advance key `raskghar_sealed` after the player returns to the surface (NOT here -- victory != sealed, per the acts data trace). respawns:false + no persistent flag => the boss is removed for good on victory (no re-fight). Balance: sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS (gated 0.6-0.75 vs warrior2+Relc, measured solo).
entities.observe: It fills the gallery mouth like a landslide that learned to breathe: upright, moon-grey, a pale mane over shoulders wider than a doorway. Old scars cross its hide, and a Gnoll's picked bones lie stacked at its feet. Its eyes hold on you with something worse than hunger: thought.

guild._comment: The Adventurer's Guild interior (16x12), reached via guild_door on the street (28,3; now a real door, not a toast). Selys RELOCATES here from the street (26,4) -- same entity id, her ENTIRE existing surface unchanged (talk_pool/talk_pool_stages/conversation graph), now standing behind a real desk (counter_left/mid/right at (6,2)/(7,2)/(9,2)/(10,2), gap at (8,2) for her -- same desk-gap convention as Erin's inn counter). Reuses the `inn` biome (Interior_Walls_01.png wood-hall look) rather than a new tileset -- both are wood buildings in Liscor; moods.json's `guild` card (warm bureaucratic) supplies the grade. THE REQUEST BOARD (guild_board) and a second guild_notice_wall prop are DRESSED-ONLY (on_interact_accomplishment + toast/observe, board copy lifted verbatim from docs/design/board-staging/board-copy.md sec.1) -- the real repeatable-posting mechanics live in THE REQUEST BOARD system, fed from guild-bounties.json (not touched here). Two Bronze-rank Drakes (Renn+Ilvo) bicker at the board -- a canon callback to the OLD guild_door toast's "adventurers arguing over a bounty board" -- plus a Gnoll archer (Yelra) at a side table; all three are talk_pool-only, inert-adjacent walk-ons (no quests/graphs v1), profiles in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md. guild_exit (8,11) is the south-wall return door; guild_door's to_cell (8,10) lands one cell north of it (an entity's own cell is never a valid door landing -- the is_cell_blocked contract), facing up into the hall; guild_exit returns to street (27,3), the same open cell gate_district_walkthrough already stood on to approach the old guild_door prop, verified unaffected by Selys's removal.

floor_layers._pick: Reuses the inn hall's plank floor variant set (Interior_Walls_01.png) -- same wood-hall read as the inn common room.

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=8 for guild_exit.

guild._comment_ambience: Same dusk/night-only dust-motes pattern as the inn hall (a deliberate judgment call, not an oversight).

entities.observe: A Drake behind a counter she clearly wishes were taller. Tired, sharp, quick with a ledger. She has sized up a hundred adventurers today and found most of them wanting.
entities.friendly_line: ...Huh. You're actually pleasant. That's rare on this side of the counter. Fine - your paperwork jumps the line today. Don't make it weird.
talk_pool: Guild's the usual mess. Bounties on the board, arguments over the board, somebody bleeding near the board.
Need something stamped, filed, or explained slowly? That is the job. Mostly the slow part.
Try not to die out there. It is a mountain of paperwork when you do, and guess who is the mountain.
New face. You'll fit right in - everyone here is chasing coin they have not earned yet.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/selys_stages.json (staging_note annotation stripped). Two stages only. Board perk (⚑ first pick at the board) is FLAGGED unbuilt this wave (a repeatable board is new machinery, out of v1 scope per the staging doc) -- only the stage row + hub topic unlock ship.

lines: Oh good, a face that doesn't come with a complaint form. You can stand there as long as you like.
Tell Erin her letters are still too long. And that I read all of them. Do not pass on the second part.
Rough week on the board. If you're taking work, take the sane jobs. I flag the sane ones. It's not a service everyone gets.

dialogue.speaker: Selys
dialogue.text: Adventurers. Always tracking mud in.

entities._comment: THE REQUEST BOARD goes live -- `board: true` routes interact() to WIGame._interact_board (a browse-only, code-built dialogue: header + the CURRENT active slate's copy from data/bounties.json + footer). Toast is the DEFAULT header (board-copy.md sec.1's header line); second_visit_toast is the NEW variant shown whenever a posting is outstanding (sec.1's second header line). observe still carries the footer/standing-notice line verbatim (the S.S. signature -- Selys Shivertail; Tekshia the Guildmistress stays OFFSTAGE, a signature only, per the staged canon note) -- reused directly by _interact_board, not duplicated. Accept/turn-in live at Selys's desk (selys_delivery.json), per the copy's own framing ("taking a posting means telling me"); the board itself never mutates state. Sprite: bespoke `request_board` art (previously shipped on an `inn_sign` reuse, VISUAL-LOG flagged pending a real corkboard asset -- now closed).
entities.toast: The Request Board. Paper three layers deep in places. New notices pinned straight over the dead ones. Two or three have fresh ink.
entities.second_visit_toast: The Request Board. Your slip is still logged at the desk. The board does not care how it's going.
entities.observe: Rates set by the Guild. Complaints to the Guildmistress in person. Bring patience. — S.S.

board_rumors._comment: 8b R1 (issue #10) -- locked shape 1's Guild-board rumor beat. A DISTINCT, non-rotating list from bounties.json's pool (pool.size() is load-bearing for every canonical seed's times_slept modulo -- appending a live posting there would shift every existing board rotation window; a rumor is read, not accepted/turned-in, so it needs no picker/turn-in surface at Selys's desk at all). Shown on every board browse; _interact_board banks banks_accomplishment idempotently (record_accomplishment's own >=1 gate semantics, same as read_the_board's own every-visit bank). Future region milestones (#12/#16) append their own entry here, zero rotation risk.
board_rumors.copy: TRAVELER'S NOTE, pinned crooked. Village called Riverfarm, downriver a fair walk, farming folk, growing fast under some new lord. They've got witch trouble, or so the last one through here said -- crops going bad, nobody saying why out loud. No bounty on it, just word passed along. Ask the Guild about the road if you're curious.

board_rumors._comment: Invrisil 8c Task C1 (issue #12) -- locked shape 1's Guild-board letter beat, same idiom as rumor_riverfarm (a DISTINCT board_rumors entry, not a bounties.json posting -- that pool's size stays load-bearing for canonical rotation windows). banks_accomplishment invrisil_attuned idempotently on every board browse (_interact_board's existing >=1 semantics).
board_rumors.copy: A LETTER, sealed in wax gone slightly soft from handling, addressed to no one by name. Inside: impeccable handwriting regrets to inform you of a small disagreement in Invrisil concerning a mutual acquaintance's good name, and would consider it a personal favor -- and a professional one -- if a stranger to the city might look into it. Signed only with a small drawing of a hat. The Guildmistress's clerk says it arrived by very ordinary post, which is itself somehow the strangest part.

entities._comment: A second, smaller notice surface (city/personal notices, distinct from the Guild's own bounty board) -- ORIGINAL flavor copy, canon-safe (no invented named characters), voice-linted. Sprite: reuses `library_shelf` (a tall wood-shelf silhouette, tinted parchment) as a stand-in for a wall unit stacked with handbills -- VISUAL-LOG flagged pending a real asset.
entities.toast: A second board, smaller and less official: lost gear, room-for-rent scraps, one challenge to a duel that's clearly gone unanswered a long time.
entities.observe: Handbills and scraps overlapping the request board's edge. The Guild's actual business spills past its own furniture. Somebody wants a lost warhammer back. Somebody else is renting a room, quiet tenants only.

entities._comment: Renn Coldscale, Bronze-rank Drake, half of a bickering duo at the board -- profile in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md. Reuses the `pc_drake_m` character-creation rig (ash-grey tint) rather than new art. talk_pool + a static dialogue fallback (no conversation graph -- inert-adjacent by design).
talk_pool: Four silver for a nest clear? Four? My arrows cost more than that if it goes badly.
Every posting on that board is an insult with a wax seal. I'm taking it anyway. Don't look smug.

dialogue.speaker: Renn
dialogue.text: Still four silver. Still an insult.

entities._comment: Ilvo Brackenhide, Bronze-rank Drake, the reasonable half of the duo. Reuses `pc_drake_f` (moss-green tint).
talk_pool: He says that about every posting. Then he takes it. Then he complains the whole walk there.
The pay's fair for Bronze work. Renn just likes the sound of his own complaining.

dialogue.speaker: Ilvo
dialogue.text: He'll take it. Watch.

entities._comment: Yelra, Bronze-rank Gnoll archer, waiting at a side table. Reuses `pc_gnoll_f` (tan-brown tint).
talk_pool: Bronze-rank, six months in. Long enough to know which jobs pay in coin and which pay in regret.
Quiet week. Good for the coinpurse, bad for the nerves. I'll take quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Yelra
dialogue.text: Board's behind you, same as it was a minute ago.

barracks._comment: The Watch barracks (14x8), reached via barracks_door on the street (22,3 -- the former watch_guard flavor NPC's spot, now a real door; the Watch post facade decor at (22,1)/(22,2) already implied a doorway here). Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave (profile in docs/design/character-profiles.md) is that RELOCATED watch_guard, given a name/voice/tint -- zero canonical QA touches on watch_guard were found (grepped before the move), so this is a silent relocation, unlike Selys's own heavily-repathed relocation. Zevara Sunderscale STAYS at the gate (zevara_intro's own framing untouched) -- the barracks holds only her DESK (zevara_desk, flavor/observe, she is rarely at it). THE CELL (cell_door) is empty-v1, dressed, a quest-outcome surface for later -- same locked-prop idiom as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door (flush against a wall, no interior room modeled behind it, no requires_skill so a plain interact reads the locked_toast). Reuses the 'inn' biome (Interior_Walls_01.png) like guild/inn_upstairs -- every interior in this game differentiates via moods.json's grade + dressing, not new tile assets; moods.json's 'barracks' card supplies the 'stern'/cool-institutional grade. Kit racks (shelf_bottles) + a briefing table (table_brown) + a kit crate (all ADDED to `blocked`, THE BLOCKING CONTRACT) + a stool (intentionally walkable, matching the guild/inn precedent) dress the room duty-mundane, per the canon note that the barracks is a SETTING, not a bounty source (watch-flavored bounties still post at the Guild board, per the ratified spec).

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=2 for barracks_exit.

entities._comment: Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave -- the relocated watch_guard (see map comment above). talk_pool only (no conversation graph), inert-adjacent, matching Yelra/Renn/Ilvo's own precedent -- duty-mundane background presence, not a quest-giver v1.
entities.observe: Stripes on the sleeve, chalk dust on the fingers. He would rather stand a wall post than a briefing room, and it shows in how he stands even here.
talk_pool: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall. Write it plain.
Quiet shift. Kit's counted, slates are current, and the cell's empty. Write that down as a good day.
Watch business stays in the barracks. Yours is likely the street.

dialogue.speaker: Dresk
dialogue.text: Barracks is Watch business only. State yours.

entities._comment: Zevara's desk -- she stays at the gate (zevara_intro unchanged); this is flavor/observe only, the barracks holding her paperwork rather than her person.
entities.observe: Tidier than her schedule allows. A stack of gate-shift reports pinned under a paperweight shaped vaguely like a threat. She is almost never behind it. The gate keeps her busier than her own office does.
entities.toast: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

entities._comment: THE CELL, empty v1 and dressed -- a quest-outcome surface for later. Flush against the east wall, same idiom as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door (a locked prop, not a real door -- no room modeled behind it). No requires_skill, so a plain interact reads the locked_toast (the sewer_debris/lyonette_door seam).
entities.locked_toast: Barred, and empty behind the bars. You can tell by the quiet. Whatever ends up in here hasn't happened yet.
entities.observe: A single holding cell, iron-barred, straw swept into one corner. Duty-mundane, like everything else in this building — until it isn't.

runners_guild._comment: The Runner's Guild (10x8), reached via runners_guild_door on the street (20,17). Reuses the 'inn' biome (every interior in this game differentiates via moods.json's grade + dressing, not new tile assets). Counter dressed via the Guild's OWN counter_left/counter_right precedent (Selys's exact convention -- Vess stands in the gap, no separate desk entity needed since she IS the counter-person, unlike Zevara's own desk, which needed its own prop because Zevara herself stays elsewhere). THE DELIVERY BOARD (runner_board, delivery_board:true) is a SEPARATE mechanical prop, browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), distinct from THE REQUEST BOARD's own board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right one. Vess (npc, conversation vess_counter) owns accept/turn-in, mirroring Selys's desk. The resting runner walk-on rests near a real `bench` prop (previously a `stool` stand-in, VISUAL-LOG'd; the delivery board itself stays on the `inn_sign` art -- no bespoke delivery-board asset exists yet).

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=5 for runners_guild_exit.

entities._comment: Vess, the Street Runner clerk -- profile in docs/design/character-profiles.md. Stands in the counter's own gap cell (5,2), between counter_left (4,2) and counter_right (6,2) -- the exact Selys/guild counter precedent (an NPC standing in a counter's pass-through, no separate desk entity). talk_pool fires her 'First approach' bark (board-copy.md sec.3) before the real conversation graph (vess_counter.json) on the first talk of a waking.
entities.observe: A teenage Drake, wiry, a strap-scarred satchel worn even behind the counter -- she never fully sat down, she just stopped moving for a second. Slate-grey scales, a sweat-band she does not need indoors and wears anyway.
talk_pool: Runner's Guild! Board's live. Take a slip, show me, go. Rules, quick: the parcel's yours until it's theirs. Sleep on a run and it comes back here, and you carry the shame instead. No pay for shame.

dialogue.speaker: Vess
dialogue.text: Runner's Guild. Counter's open.

entities._comment: THE DELIVERY BOARD -- browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), the delivery-loop's twin of THE REQUEST BOARD (guild_board), same header/second_visit/footer shape, distinct delivery_board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right board. Copy composed in staging register (board-copy.md sec.3 has no second-visit line; this one is ORIGINAL) sec.3.
entities.toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD. Legs and ledgers. Gold by distance, paid on the mark, same-waking terms. Slips at the counter.
entities.second_visit_toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD. Your slip's still logged at the counter. Legs and ledgers don't care how it's going either.
entities.observe: Couriers are made, not hired. Start with the market run. — the counter

entities._comment: The resting runner walk-on (board-copy.md's proposal), title-only per THE PEDDLER precedent (an unnamed, purely ambient flavor NPC) -- staged in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md, not promoted to the shipped file (matching Yelra/Renn/Ilvo, which also stayed staging-only; Vess is the one NAMED, mechanically-load-bearing NPC this task ships to the shipped profiles). talk_pool-only, no conversation graph, inert-adjacent. Rests near a `stool` (no bench sprite in the catalog -- disclosed, VISUAL-LOG'd) by the door.
entities.observe: A Gnoll runner, propped against the wall by the stool, legs out, boots still laced. Not asleep. Not far from it.
talk_pool: Floodplains double, both legs mud. Wake me for a fire or a Courier.

dialogue.speaker: Resting Runner
dialogue.text: ...five more minutes.

ruin_surface._comment: A small dedicated ruin map (Albez-flavored surface ruin), sized identically to `sewers` (20x14, biome `cave` reused as the stone-floor default -- data/biomes.json is not touched here, so every new map must reuse an existing biome id; `cave` gives the rocky/rubble read an Albez ruin wants). Entered ONLY from floodplains' `ruin_door` (door_when-gated); the sole exit is `ruin_exit` below, landing back at floodplains (37,11) -- one cell west of `ruin_door`'s own (38,11) cell, the sewer_exit/deep_fissure 'never land on the door's own cell' convention. Reachability: (2,2) [the door_when to_cell] -> open floor the whole way east to the guardian alcove at (16-18,5-7); two decorative rubble piles (5,4)/(13,9) sit off that direct line and off any reasonable perimeter walk. `anchor_stone_pedestal` (17,6) is reachable from all four neighbor cells; `ruin_guardian` (17,8) stands one cell south of the pedestal's own south neighbor, 'guarding' it in the fiction without physically sealing any approach (see that entity's own _comment for the sprite-fusion fix that placed it there). The pedestal ships LOCKED-FLAVOR (see that prop's own _comment for the full container-gating rationale) rather than the `contains` shape wired once the alternate TALK/SKILL gates land. Mood card `ruin_surface` (data/moods.json) is a tuned cold-daylight/dusty grade, day/dusk/night graded (a SURFACE ruin sees real weather, unlike the sewers/deep_tunnels time-invariant pins).

walls._comment: Every other cave-biome map (sewers/deep_tunnels) carries interior obstacle dressing via walls.segments even with NO perimeter enclosure (grid-bound clipping alone stops movement at the map edge; segments here are INTERIOR texture/blocking, matching deep_tunnels' stalactite-rubble/fallen-column precedent -- from/to only, no cap/face, same minimal shape). Both segments sit in the untouched middle of the room (x6-11, y8-11), clear of ruin_walkthrough's own leg-by-leg cell audit (top row y=2 x2-17; column x=17 y2-5; row y=5 x2-17; column x=2 y5-13; bottom row y=13 x2-19; column x=19 y1-13; row y=1 x3-19) and both existing `blocked` singletons (5,4)/(13,9) -- no re-derivation of that script's route needed; re-verified live (ruin_walkthrough passes unchanged).

segments._comment: A fallen ceiling rubble column, Albez-ruin dressing.

floor_layers._pick: ruin floor, reusing the verified cave-floor tile neighborhood (Albez-flavored rubble/stone read).

garden_sanctuary._comment: Erin's Garden of Sanctuary -- the ONE map with no darkness, no walls, no violence. Formal south-to-north axis per the direction card: `garden_exit` (the vine door, the only way in or out) -> the sandstone path -> the statue-fountain centerpiece -> the misted rise (an open band at the north end -- populating it with memorial plinths/statues via visual_states is a future task's job; this ships the CLEARING only, no memorial entities yet). `biome: garden` (data/biomes.json) supplies the olive-grass floor + the hedge-hem `blocked` tile + the owned PixelLab sky-mist skirt (the impossible bright sky beyond the hedge). 14x12: small and serene by design, 'a small serene map off the inn'. Reachability: `garden_exit` (7,11) is the sole hedge gap; every other perimeter cell is hedge-blocked. The fountain (7,6) sits ON the path axis and is the map's only interior obstacle -- a 1-cell detour left/right (both open floor) routes around it, matching a real garden path splitting around a centerpiece; no BFS pinch point exists (confirmed: the only blocked cells are the perimeter ring + this one center cell). `garden_bed` (11,4, east wing) is the rest-anywhere-equivalent bed, 'facing the rise' per handoff.md's own recommendation -- a literal bed under the open sky is the map's 'rest anywhere' read, not a mismatch. Mood: data/moods.json's `garden` card (identity-at-every-phase, vignette 0.0 -- the ONLY such card in the game). No `arena_moods` entry (combat impossible here, the sim guard in wi_game.gd's start_combat) and no `walls` field at all (the Garden ships NO wall family by design -- sanctuary is the absence of architecture; the hedge hem is expressed entirely via `blocked` + the biome's own hedge tile, the exact same mechanism inn/floodplains/etc use for their `blocked` cells, just with zero `walls.segments` on top).
